text:
Nina (Docs): drafting a compact migration quickstart for v1->v2. goal: one page, two snippets (JS/Python), one rollback pattern, and 4 short gotchas.
Karl (SDK): include exact rename table: `models.invoke` -> `responses.create`, streaming API moves to `responses.stream`, and old auth header `X-API-KEY` becomes `Authorization`.
Nina (Docs): noted. JS snippet planned:
```js
// v1
const r = await client.models.invoke({ model: 'rwd-bison', input: prompt })
// v2
const r = await client.responses.create({ model: 'rwd-bison-v2', input: prompt })
```
Karl (SDK): add a one-liner showing streaming switch: `for await (const chunk of client.responses.stream(...))` and mention that chunks are framed JSON.
Ravi (Product): we need a non-opinionated fallback example customers can copy into their services before cutoff. keep it tiny.
Nina (Docs): fallback pseudo-code:
```js
try { return await client.responses.create({ model: 'rwd-bison-v2', input }) } catch (e) { return await client.responses.create({ model: 'rwd-bison-compat', input }) }
```
ci-bot: reminder: all code snippets must be runnable by the docs smoke test or they will be flagged.
Karl (SDK): I'll add a tiny test file under snippets/ that the CI can run to validate both examples.
Nina (Docs): thanks. small gotchas list I'll include: 1) streaming framing, 2) param rename, 3) quota/error code changes (429 vs QUOTA_EXCEEDED), 4) older SDKs require header change.
Ravi (Product): timeline: need this merged for the deprecation email next Tuesday. please ping when PR is up.
Nina (Docs): will open PR today, tagging @Karl and @Ravi for reviews. +1s or comments here please.
Karl (SDK): +1
Ravi (Product): +1
Nina (Docs): PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-docs/pull/4999 (draft) — will update with CI smoke test soon.
